title: Absolute sum of an initial segment
statement: Let $R$ be a linearly ordered additive commutative group whose order is preserved by addition, let $l$ be a finite list in $R$, and let $k\in\mathbb{N}$. The absolute value of the sum of the first $k$ entries of $l$ (or all its entries if it has fewer than $k$) is at most the sum of the absolute values of all entries of $l$.
